---
title: "scHiCImpute Diagnostic: One Chromosome, One Cluster"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(36)
```

## 1) Setup

```{r libs}
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "tibble", "HiCImpute", "ggplot2")
missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(HiCImpute)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 2) Config

```{r config}
anchor_path <- file.path("external", "SCORE", "examples", "data", "mm10.genome_split_1M")
raw_pair_dir <- file.path("external", "SCORE", "examples", "data", "oocyte_zygote_mm10", "1M")
ref_path <- file.path("external", "SCORE", "examples", "data", "oocyte_zygote_ref")

target_chr <- "chr1"
target_cluster <- "oocyte"
target_cell <- NULL
min_depth <- 5000

mc.cores <- 1
cutoff <- 0.5
niter <- 1000
burnin <- 500
```

## 3) Load Inputs

```{r load_inputs}
if (!file.exists(anchor_path)) stop("Missing anchor file: ", anchor_path)
if (!dir.exists(raw_pair_dir)) stop("Missing raw pair dir: ", raw_pair_dir)
if (!file.exists(ref_path)) stop("Missing reference file: ", ref_path)

anchors <- read.delim(anchor_path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(anchors) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "idx0")

ref <- read.delim(ref_path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!all(c("cell", "depth", "cluster") %in% names(ref))) {
  stop("Reference file must include columns: cell, depth, cluster")
}

normalize_key <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("\\.1m$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x
}

pair_tbl <- tibble(
  cell_file = list.files(raw_pair_dir, full.names = FALSE),
  key = normalize_key(cell_file)
)

ref2 <- ref %>%
  filter(depth >= min_depth, cluster == target_cluster) %>%
  mutate(key = normalize_key(cell)) %>%
  left_join(pair_tbl, by = "key") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_file)) %>%
  distinct(cell_file, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (nrow(ref2) < 2) stop("Too few cells after filtering for cluster: ", target_cluster)

chr_ids <- anchors$idx0[anchors$chr == target_chr]
n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
if (n_bins < 2) stop("Too few bins for chromosome: ", target_chr)

cat("Cluster:", target_cluster, "\n")
cat("Chromosome:", target_chr, "\n")
cat("Cells kept:", nrow(ref2), "\n")
cat("Bins:", n_bins, "\n")
```

## 4) Build 2D Matrices Per Cell

```{r build_matrices}
read_pair_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) {
    return(data.frame(bin1 = integer(0), bin2 = integer(0), count = numeric(0)))
  }
  x <- tryCatch(read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) data.frame())
  if (nrow(x) == 0 || ncol(x) < 3) {
    return(data.frame(bin1 = integer(0), bin2 = integer(0), count = numeric(0)))
  }
  x <- x[, 1:3]
  colnames(x) <- c("bin1", "bin2", "count")
  x$bin1 <- as.integer(x$bin1)
  x$bin2 <- as.integer(x$bin2)
  x$count <- as.numeric(x$count)
  x <- x[!is.na(x$bin1) & !is.na(x$bin2) & !is.na(x$count), , drop = FALSE]
  x
}

build_chr_mat <- function(dt, chr_ids) {
  n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins)
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(mat)

  keep <- dt$bin1 %in% chr_ids & dt$bin2 %in% chr_ids
  d <- dt[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(mat)

  old2new <- integer(max(chr_ids) + 1L)
  old2new[chr_ids + 1L] <- seq_len(n_bins)
  i <- old2new[d$bin1 + 1L]
  j <- old2new[d$bin2 + 1L]
  ok <- i > 0 & j > 0 & !is.na(i) & !is.na(j)
  i <- i[ok]
  j <- j[ok]
  w <- d$count[ok]
  if (length(i) == 0) return(mat)

  for (k in seq_along(i)) {
    ii <- i[k]
    jj <- j[k]
    mat[ii, jj] <- mat[ii, jj] + w[k]
    if (ii != jj) mat[jj, ii] <- mat[jj, ii] + w[k]
  }
  mat
}

scHiC_list <- lapply(ref2$cell_file, function(cf) {
  build_chr_mat(read_pair_file(file.path(raw_pair_dir, cf)), chr_ids)
})
names(scHiC_list) <- ref2$cell_file

if (is.null(target_cell)) {
  target_cell <- names(scHiC_list)[1]
}
if (!target_cell %in% names(scHiC_list)) {
  stop("target_cell not found in selected cluster: ", target_cell)
}

bulk_mat <- Reduce(`+`, scHiC_list)
cat("Example cell:", target_cell, "\n")
```

## 5) Run scHiCImpute

```{r run_hicimpute}
fit <- HiCImpute::MCMCImpute(
  scHiC = scHiC_list,
  bulk = bulk_mat,
  expected = NULL,
  n = n_bins,
  mc.cores = mc.cores,
  cutoff = cutoff,
  niter = niter,
  burnin = burnin
)

cell_idx <- match(target_cell, names(scHiC_list))
raw_mat <- scHiC_list[[cell_idx]]

upper_to_mat <- function(v, n) {
  mat <- matrix(0, n, n)
  mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)] <- as.numeric(v)
  mat + t(mat)
}

imp_all_mat <- upper_to_mat(fit$Impute_All[, cell_idx], n_bins)
imp_sz_mat <- upper_to_mat(fit$Impute_SZ[, cell_idx], n_bins)
```

## 6) Heatmaps: Raw vs Impute_All vs Impute_SZ

```{r heatmap_data}
mat_to_df <- function(mat, label) {
  n <- nrow(mat)
  expand.grid(i = seq_len(n), j = seq_len(n), KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      count = as.numeric(mat[cbind(i, j)]),
      panel = label
    )
}

heat_df <- bind_rows(
  mat_to_df(raw_mat, "Raw"),
  mat_to_df(imp_all_mat, "Impute_All"),
  mat_to_df(imp_sz_mat, "Impute_SZ")
) %>%
  mutate(
    panel = factor(panel, levels = c("Raw", "Impute_All", "Impute_SZ")),
    value = log1p(count)
  )

pos_vals <- heat_df$value[is.finite(heat_df$value) & heat_df$value > 0]
count_max <- if (length(pos_vals) > 0) {
  as.numeric(stats::quantile(pos_vals, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE))
} else {
  suppressWarnings(max(heat_df$value, na.rm = TRUE))
}
if (!is.finite(count_max)) count_max <- 1
count_max <- max(count_max, 1e-6)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = j, y = i, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 3, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, count_max),
    option = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "log1p"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("scHiCImpute Diagnostic | ", target_chr, " | ", target_cluster, " | cell: ", target_cell),
    subtitle = "Compare Raw vs Impute_All vs Impute_SZ within one cluster",
    x = "bin",
    y = "bin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_heat)
```

## 7) Quick Sparsity Summary

```{r quick_summary}
count_nonzero_upper <- function(mat) {
  sum(mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
}

summary_tbl <- tibble(
  panel = c("Raw", "Impute_All", "Impute_SZ"),
  nonzero_upper = c(
    count_nonzero_upper(raw_mat),
    count_nonzero_upper(imp_all_mat),
    count_nonzero_upper(imp_sz_mat)
  ),
  total_upper = n_bins * (n_bins - 1) / 2
) %>%
  mutate(nonzero_pct = round(100 * nonzero_upper / total_upper, 2))

print(summary_tbl)
```
